title: Sprites drawn into a transparent render target with SRC_ALPHA blending for alpha, then layered with SRC_ALPHA again
expected_finding: sprite_batch blends straight-alpha sprites into sprite_layer_target with (SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) for alpha too, leaving premultiplied colour with alpha squared; present_layer blends that premultiplied target with SRC_ALPHA, multiplying colour by alpha again (a 50% sprite shows at ~25% or less)
